text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Ines 
Fujin...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, Paka Petit! They're all so cute~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fuujin was gazing at a crane game 
filled with plushies styled after 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"My little sisters beg me all the time, 
too, but I'm really bad at crane games... 
Ahaha."
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll get it for you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, don't mind if I do! Big Sis 
will cheer you on with all her might!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —I can't afford to lose this game!!
